info.name: Solar Business Platform API
info.description: Complete API collection for the Solar Inverter Business Platform backend. All admin endpoints require a Bearer access token in the Authorization header. The refresh token is stored in an HttpOnly cookie automatically by the browser/Postman.

variable.description: Paste access token from login response here. Never store secrets in the collection.

request.description: Creates an admin account. Requires X-Registration-Key header matching server env var. Role is always 'admin' regardless of body.
Returns accessToken in JSON body. Sets HttpOnly refreshToken cookie. The test script auto-saves the accessToken to the collection variable.
Reads refreshToken from HttpOnly cookie. Returns new accessToken. Rotates refresh token (old one is revoked).
Revokes refresh token from DB. Clears HttpOnly cookie. Always returns 200.
Returns the authenticated admin profile. Requires Bearer token.
Changes password. Revokes all refresh sessions on success.
Always returns 200 to prevent email enumeration. In development mode, _dev_resetToken is returned for testing.
Resets password using single-use token from forgot-password. Revokes all refresh sessions.
